data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 61.3 million, primarily driven by the impact of the Ogden discount rate change on motor reinsurance and general liability classes. This adverse development contributed to an overall loss for the 2016 calendar year and a reduced closed year profit for the 2014 year of account. Additionally, a loss of GBP 15.7 million was incurred on business inherited through the reinsurance to close of the 2013 year of account. The syndicate also noted an increased prevalence of global natural disasters, though specific impacts on prior year reserves were not quantified beyond the Ogden rate.

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative text on pages 3 and 20 states a net increase in reserves of GBP 33.1 million for 2014 and prior underwriting years. However, the gross claims development table on page 13 indicates a gross strengthening of GBP 61.3 million for the same period (excluding the 2010&P aggregate column and the two most recent underwriting years). The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions.
